stem: A batch reaches its target average moisture content, but thick flowers remain wetter inside. What is the main QA concern?
choices: Average moisture proves every piece is stable
Spatial moisture gradients can remain, so representative product measurements and water-activity/stability checks are needed
The room RH alone proves product condition
Drying should stop based only on elapsed days
rationale: Average moisture can hide heterogeneity; product condition and water availability need representative evaluation.
